scope: Smallest build-gated R1 implementation slice: supervisor-born lapis_session_service ownership, protocol-identity adoption, authoritative reconnect and join clients, reconstruction, and explicit stop. This is not integrated GUI birth or persistent supervisor acceptance.
implemented: Headless session-service launcher builds the existing service command without fixture-only supervisor arguments.
Service accepts an exact --session-epoch HEX32; restart rotates service epoch and spawn token while preserving session ID.
Launcher writes a private spawn-token/PID ownership record and performs a non-authoritative v6 join handshake.
Launcher retries only the service's transient overloaded startup status and validates/canonicalizes the child payload exactly as the service does.
Adoption validates live PID, service executable, owner token, desired launch fingerprint and protocol identity; stale identity and fingerprint mismatch are rejected.
The handshake drains already-buffered Unix-domain reads and accepts a synchronous Qt flush without misreading an empty pending-write queue as failure.
Focused integration source exercises authoritative reconnect, join detach/rejoin, detached output, supervisor reconstruction and authenticated explicit stop.

addressed: alive() reaps a forked service so a crash is visible and the restart path can fire
terminate() verifies the PID still runs the service before signalling a process group and falls back to a single-process signal
adoption keeps the ownership record for a live verified peer whose handshake fails
a throwing post-fork ownership read kills, reaps and cleans the forked service before rethrowing
the service log path is materialized before fork()
the handshake shares one bounded 20-second budget, sleeps between attempts, and leaves an aborted socket on a startup-overload reply
process_runs_program() fails the build on POSIX platforms without executable discovery
terminal size is validated before fingerprint truncation
the session-service test derives its temporary directory per platform and skips when binds are unavailable
the checker rejects an --output outside the checkout and records source-revision failures in a failure receipt
restart refuses to republish an unchanged session epoch or spawn token, with focused refusal coverage
